environment.description: Kafka cluster (MSK) deployed in a VPC with public-facing bootstrap endpoints enabled. The 'user-profile-updates' topic has open ACLs (ALLOW * on WRITE for principal User:*). Any authenticated Kafka client on the internet can produce messages to the topic. The consumer service runs on ECS Fargate with the database in the same VPC.

config.msk_cluster_auth: SASL/SCRAM with shared credentials in public documentation
config.network: MSK public bootstrap endpoints enabled, security group allows 0.0.0.0/0 on port 9096
config.consumer_runtime: ECS Fargate, same VPC as RDS PostgreSQL
